tool_input.description: Show historical content of revoke-tls-backend.json decision file

result: Created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. I checked both muninn's memory and the git history directly: a chat decision (#19) once set the TLS backend to rustls, but the config file that tracked it (`config/decisions/revoke-tls-backend.json`) was deleted in the most recent commit (7421979, "move decision config out of the tree") along with nine other decision files, and nothing replaced it anywhere in the repo. Since that removal is the most recent, commit-confirmed event on this subject, I recorded that nothing current is on record rather than restating the retired rustls/openssl values.
